summary: @ornikar/jest-config-react-native preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package advertised as a Jest preset ships a `preinstall` hook (`setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub for the installer's platform, extracts it via a hand-rolled ZIP central-directory parser, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling ~728KB `math_init.js` file. The install script itself is obfuscator.io-style renamed (`_0x…` identifiers, string-lookup tables) and `math_init.js` is a single-line string-array-rotated blob (`WV8StW` shift function, hex-encoded literals, `@bun @bun-cjs` header) with no relation to Jest configuration. The combination — obfuscated lifecycle script, alien-runtime dropper, and opaque payload executed outside Node's normal load path — gives whoever published this arbitrary code execution on every installer at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
